description: Claude Platform on AWS is an Anthropic-operated Claude API integration with AWS IAM authentication and AWS Marketplace billing. It is separate from AWS-operated Amazon Bedrock.
residency_notes: Claude Platform on AWS is Anthropic-operated and uses the Claude API with AWS billing and IAM. Workspaces bind to any AWS commercial region for the gateway and AWS-side resources, but that region does not determine inference location. Inference defaults to global routing and can be pinned to US with inference_geo on Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and later models. Anthropic processes customer content outside the AWS security boundary; workspace data residency is US-only.
prompt_training_notes: Anthropic says customer API data is not used to train its models by default.
user_identifier_notes: Phaseo does not currently send this provider a provider-facing user identifier in the Anthropic chat adapter.
regional_pricing_notes: Displayed pricing reflects the standard Claude API rate card billed through AWS Marketplace CCUs. Anthropic documents a 1.1x multiplier for US-only inference on Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and later models when inference_geo is set to us.

sources.notes: Verified Anthropic-operated architecture, AWS regional gateway, Claude API route and model-ID format, authentication, model availability, US/global inference geographies, lifecycle relationship, retention, and AWS Marketplace billing.
Verified standard token rates billed as Claude Consumption Units and the 1.1x US-only inference multiplier.

verification.notes: Provider purpose, route, endpoint pattern, model-ID format, supported models, regions, retention, lifecycle, and pricing were checked against current official Claude Platform documentation.
